gram.biomass_addition: High root nodule biomass adds ~20-30 kg/ha atmospheric nitrogen

recommended_next_crops.reason: Maize is a heavy nitrogen consumer and thrives on residual legume nitrogen.
Excellent post-kharif/rabi cereal rotation with reduced fertilizer requirement.
Breaks soil-borne pest cycles and restores topsoil structure for deep roots.

crops_to_avoid.reason: Repeated pulse cultivation can build up Fusarium wilt and root rot pathogens in soil.

soil_health_tips: Incorporate pulse crop residues directly into soil to accelerate microbial humification.
Residual soil moisture after gram is ideal for early rabi or zaid sowing.
soil_health_tips_kn: ಕಡಲೆಯ ಉಳಿಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮಣ್ಣಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆರೆಸುವುದರಿಂದ ಜೈವಿಕ ಇಂಗಾಲ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾರಜನಕ ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತದೆ.
ಕಡಲೆಯ ನಂತರ ಮುಸುಕಿನ ಜೋಳ ಅಥವಾ ಗೋಧಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುವುದು ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಲಾಭದಾಯಕ.

soyabean.biomass_addition: Dense foliage drop enriches organic carbon and fixes 30-40 kg N/ha

recommended_next_crops.reason: Classic soybean-wheat cropping system gives highest fertilizer efficiency.
Low moisture rabi legume rotation in dry tracts.
Sorghum benefits from residual organic nitrogen and loose soil tilth.

crops_to_avoid.reason: Continuous legume cropping invites Rhizoctonia and nematode buildup.

soil_health_tips: Leaf-fall prior to harvest deposits natural mulch, conserving moisture and enriching topsoil organic matter.
soil_health_tips_kn: ಉದುರಿದ ಎಲೆಗಳು ನೈಸರ್ಗಿಕ ಮಲ್ಚಿಂಗ್ ಆಗಿ ಮಣ್ಣಿನ ತೇವಾಂಶ ಮತ್ತು ಫಲವತ್ತತೆ ಕಾಪಾಡುತ್ತವೆ.

vigna-radiati(Mung).biomass_addition: Quick 60-day crop adds fast-decomposing green manure biomass

recommended_next_crops.reason: Moong green-manure residue before transplanted paddy cuts urea requirement by 25%.
Cereal succession makes optimal use of fixed nitrogen.
Moong-mustard is a premier short-season cash rotation.

soil_health_tips: Plough under crop residues immediately after second picking for maximum green manuring benefit.
soil_health_tips_kn: ಕಾಯಿ ಬಿಡಿಸಿದ ನಂತರ ಗಿಡಗಳನ್ನು ಮಣ್ಣಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಉತ್ತು ಹಸಿರೆಲೆ ಗೊಬ್ಬರವಾಗಿಸಿ.

maize.biomass_addition: High stubble biomass but draws heavy N, P and K reserves

recommended_next_crops.reason: Legume restores soil nitrogen depleted by heavy-feeding maize crop.
Recovers organic matter and breaks stem-borer pest cycle.
Groundnut nodules actively replenish the nitrogen deficit.

crops_to_avoid.reason: Consecutive heavy cereal crops exhaust soil micronutrients and foster stem borer.

soil_health_tips: Apply 5-8 tons of Farm Yard Manure (FYM) or vermicompost before the next crop.
Add Azotobacter bio-fertilizer with seed treatment for the incoming crop.
soil_health_tips_kn: ಮುಸುಕಿನ ಜೋಳದ ನಂತರ ಕಡ್ಡಾಯವಾಗಿ ಕಡಲೆ ಅಥವಾ ದ್ವಿದಳ ಧಾನ್ಯ ಬೆಳೆಯಿರಿ.
ಮುಂದಿನ ಬೆಳೆಗೆ 5 ಟನ್ ಕೊಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಗೊಬ್ಬರ ಸೇರಿಸಿ.

rice.biomass_addition: Anaerobic puddling reduces soil structure and hardens subsoil layer

recommended_next_crops.reason: Relay pulse cropping (utera) into drying paddy field utilizes residual moisture and fixes nitrogen.
Thrives in post-paddy moisture conditions with minimal tillage.
Breaks hardpan in sandy/alluvial paddy soils.

crops_to_avoid.reason: Monocropping paddy depletes zinc and leads to persistent methane emission and soil compaction.

soil_health_tips: Incorporate Zinc Sulphate (ZnSO4) at 10 kg/acre if signs of Khaira disease were noted.
Deep subsoil chiselling breaks the hard plough-pan created by continuous puddling.
soil_health_tips_kn: ಭತ್ತದ ನಂತರ ಕಡಲೆ ಅಥವಾ ಹೆಸರು ಬೆಳೆಯುವುದರಿಂದ ಮಣ್ಣಿನ ಬಿಗಿತ ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
ಭತ್ತದ ಗದ್ದೆಗೆ ಜಿಂಕ್ ಸಲ್ಫೇಟ್ ನೀಡಿದರೆ ಮುಂದಿನ ಬೆಳೆಗೆ ಉತ್ತಮ.

cotton.biomass_addition: Deep taproot extracts potassium and phosphorus from lower soil horizons

recommended_next_crops.reason: Legume restores biological activity and replenishes depleted nitrogen.
Fast shallow-rooted cereal prevents nutrient leaching.
Chickpea taproot works well in deep black cotton soils after cotton stalks are shredded.

crops_to_avoid.reason: Shares common bollworm, whitefly and verticillium wilt pests with cotton.

soil_health_tips: Shred cotton stalks into mulch rather than burning them to replenish 1.5 tons of organic carbon per acre.
Top-dress potash (MOP) if consecutive deep-rooted crops are planted.
soil_health_tips_kn: ಹತ್ತಿ ಗಿಡಗಳನ್ನು ಸುಡದೆ ಪುಡಿಮಾಡಿ ಮಣ್ಣಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸಿ, ಇಂಗಾಲ ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತದೆ.
ಹತ್ತಿಯ ನಂತರ ಮೆಣಸಿನಕಾಯಿ ಅಥವಾ ಟೊಮೆಟೊ ಬೆಳೆಯಬೇಡಿ (ಕೀಟ ರೋಗಗಳ ಬಾಧೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚು).

wheat.biomass_addition: Fibrous root system maintains soil aggregation and tilth

recommended_next_crops.reason: Summer moong utilizes the 65-day gap before kharif, fixing 30kg N.
Standard kharif cereal following rabi wheat.
Soybean in kharif balances the carbon-nitrogen ratio perfectly.

soil_health_tips: Do not burn wheat straw; decompose with bio-decomposer or incorporate as mulch.
soil_health_tips_kn: ಗೋಧಿ ಕೊಯ್ಲಿನ ನಂತರ ಬೇಸಿಗೆ ಹೆಸರು ಅಥವಾ ಉದ್ದು ಬೆಳೆಯಿರಿ.

sugarcane.fertility_impact_kn: ತೀವ್ರ ಕ್ಷೀಣಿಸಿದೆ (ಅಧಿಕ ಪೋಷಕಾಂಶ ಮತ್ತು ನೀರು ಬಳಕೆ)
sugarcane.biomass_addition: Enormous biomass extraction over 12-14 months heavily exhausts soil K and N

recommended_next_crops.reason: Crucial green manure crop required to restore soil organic microbial biology.
Restores nitrogen and loosens compacted subsoil.
Fast legume recovery crop.

crops_to_avoid.reason: Severe root knot nematode and red rot accumulation.

soil_health_tips: Trash mulching between rows saves 30% water and replenishes organic carbon.
Apply 10 tons of FYM or pressmud compost before rotating to next crop.
soil_health_tips_kn: ಕಬ್ಬಿನ ನಂತರ ಸೆಣಬು ಅಥವಾ ಡೈಂಚಾ ಬೆಳೆದು ಹಸಿರೆಲೆ ಗೊಬ್ಬರ ಮಾಡುವುದು ಕಡ್ಡಾಯ.
ಕಬ್ಬಿನ ರವದೆಯನ್ನು ಸುಡದೆ ಮುಚ್ಚಿಗೆ (ಮಲ್ಚಿಂಗ್) ಮಾಡಿ.

tomato.biomass_addition: Susceptible to bacterial wilt, early blight, and root-knot nematodes

recommended_next_crops.reason: Gramineae non-host cereal starves solanaceous bacterial wilt and nematodes.
Legume restores soil fertility and alters root microbial ecosystem.
Marigold roots secrete alpha-terthienyl which actively kills root-knot nematodes.

crops_to_avoid.reason: Strictly avoid Solanaceae crops consecutively to prevent catastrophic bacterial wilt and viral epidemics.

soil_health_tips: Solarize soil during summer months with transparent polythene sheets to destroy soil-borne fungal spores.
Apply Trichoderma viride and Pseudomonas fluorescens enriched in neem cake.
soil_health_tips_kn: ಟೊಮೆಟೊ ನಂತರ ಮೆಣಸಿನಕಾಯಿ ಅಥವಾ ಬದನೆ ಬೆಳೆಯಬೇಡಿ (ರೋಗಗಳ ಅಪಾಯ).
ಟೊಮೆಟೊ ನಂತರ ಮುಸುಕಿನ ಜೋಳ ಅಥವಾ ಚೆಂಡುಹೂ ಬೆಳೆದರೆ ಜಂತುಹುಳು (ನೆಮಟೋಡ್) ನಾಶವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

chilli.fertility_impact_kn: ಕ್ಷೀಣಿಸಿದೆ (ನಂಜು ರೋಗ ಮತ್ತು ಬೇರು ಕೊಳೆತ ಅಪಾಯ)
chilli.biomass_addition: High nutrient feeder with intensive micronutrient requirements

recommended_next_crops.reason: Fixes nitrogen and breaks thrips and mite pupation cycles in soil.
Tall cereal crop breaks the viral vector chain (thrips/whiteflies).
Leguminous rotation that improves topsoil porosity.

crops_to_avoid.reason: Cross-host for leaf curl virus, anthracnose and root wilt.

soil_health_tips: Drench soil with neem cake extract to suppress soil pupating thrips and mites.
Add micro-nutrient mixture (Zinc, Boron, Iron) at land preparation.
soil_health_tips_kn: ಮೆಣಸಿನಕಾಯಿ ನಂತರ ಕಡಲೆ ಅಥವಾ ಜೋಳ ಬೆಳೆಯಿರಿ.
ಟೊಮೆಟೊ ಅಥವಾ ತಂಬಾಕು ಬೆಳೆಯುವುದನ್ನು ತಪ್ಪಿಸಿ.

jowar.biomass_addition: Deep fibrous root system loosens heavy clay; slight allelopathic root exudates

recommended_next_crops.reason: Sorghum-chickpea is the most resilient dryland rainfed cropping system.
Overcomes sorghum allelopathy and replenishes nitrate nitrogen.
Deep-rooting rotation with different nutrient zone absorption.

soil_health_tips: Allow a 15-day fallow or decomposition window after sorghum harvest before sowing sensitive vegetables.
soil_health_tips_kn: ಜೋಳದ ನಂತರ ಕಡಲೆ ಬೆಳೆಯುವುದು ಒಣಬೇಸಾಯಕ್ಕೆ ಅತ್ಯುತ್ತಮ.

sunflower.biomass_addition: Deep taproot extracts subsoil moisture and breaks hard subsoil layers

recommended_next_crops.reason: Recharges soil nitrogen and benefits from loose soil structure.
Cereal after oilseed balances nutrient consumption.
Short duration green manure restores active microbial biomass.

soil_health_tips: Sunflower taproots open aeration channels in dense black soils, aiding water infiltration for subsequent crops.
soil_health_tips_kn: ಸೂರ್ಯಕಾಂತಿಯ ಆಳವಾದ ಬೇರುಗಳು ಮಣ್ಣನ್ನು ಸಡಿಲಗೊಳಿಸಿ ಗಾಳಿಯಾಡುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ.

recommended_next_crops.reason: Pulses naturally enhance soil nitrogen and break pathogen cycles.
Productive cereal crop with wide soil adaptability.

soil_health_tips: Incorporate well-rotted compost or FYM at 4-5 tonnes/acre to maintain soil fertility and microbial vigor.
soil_health_tips_kn: ಮಣ್ಣಿನ ಫಲವತ್ತತೆ ಕಾಪಾಡಲು ಎಕರೆಗೆ 4-5 ಟನ್ ಕೊಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಗೊಬ್ಬರ ಸೇರಿಸಿ.
